shadowSentences: Cooking is a great way to relax.
Traveling can open your mind to new cultures.
Listening to music helps me focus while studying.
Spending time outdoors improves my mood significantly.
Volunteering at the local shelter is very rewarding.
Learning a new language can be both fun and challenging.
Maintaining a balanced diet is key to good health.
Connecting with friends regularly enhances our relationships.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel experiences.
questions: Q1: Can you describe your most memorable travel experience?
Q2: What challenges did you face during that trip?
Q3: How do you feel traveling impacts personal growth?
Q4: What advice would you give someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about time management.
questions: Q1: How do you typically manage your time during the day?
Q2: What difficulties do you encounter in managing your schedule?
Q3: In your opinion, why is effective time management important?
Q4: What tips would you offer to help others improve their time management skills?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.
questions: Q1: What kind of exercise do you enjoy the most?
Q2: Have you ever faced any obstacles to staying active?
Q3: What benefits do you think regular exercise brings?
Q4: What suggestions do you have for someone starting a new exercise routine?
